pages.lesson:
LESSON: HUYU NA HAWA

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.13: huyu na hawa

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu huyu na hawa. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua majina ya herufi lengwa kwa kutumia kadi za herufi zinazowakilisha sauti lengwa katika kuimarisha stadi ya yanayotokana na sauti lengwa kusoma

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua majina ya herufi lengwa kwa kutumia kadi za herufi zinazowakilisha sauti lengwa katika kuimarisha stadi ya yanayotokana na sauti lengwa kusoma
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua majina ya herufi lengwa kwa kutumia kadi za herufi zinazowakilisha sauti lengwa katika kuimarisha stadi ya yanayotokana na sauti lengwa kusoma. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about huyu na hawa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about huyu na hawa in the examples.
2. Explain huyu na hawa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand huyu na hawa.
4. Show that you can: kutambua majina ya herufi lengwa kwa kutumia kadi za herufi zinazowakilisha sauti lengwa katika kuimarisha stadi ya yanayotokana na sauti lengwa kusoma

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about huyu na hawa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is huyu na hawa important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua majina ya herufi lengwa kwa kutumia kadi za herufi zinazowakilisha sauti lengwa katika kuimarisha stadi ya yanayotokana na sauti lengwa kusoma

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
